headline: Joe Shuster Signed 1940 Superman Game
post:
A rare 1940 Milton-Bradley Superman Speed Game double-signed by co-creator Joe Shuster is heading to auction next week, according to ComicBook.com. Manufactured just two years after the hero's debut, the vintage board game features an illustration alongside the artist's inscription. PSA has fully verified both signatures.

This piece of licensed merchandise includes early appearances of DC characters other than Superman, such as Perry White and Clark Kent. The gameplay involves moving pieces across a colored board using wooden dice. Although the item shows heavy wear with torn corners and tape repairs, these signs of age highlight its history.

What is your favorite classic Superman collectible? 

#Superman #JoeShuster #VintageCollectibles
original_title: This 1940 Superman Game Is A Throwback To The Hero’s Earliest Days (With An Extraordinary Twist)

headline: Hasbro reveals VHS-inspired Star Wars collection
post:
Get ready for a major blast from the past as the galaxy far, far away prepares to celebrate a massive milestone. According to Screen Rant, Hasbro is bringing the first six chapters together for a special release honoring the original and prequel trilogies.

The upcoming Star Wars: The Black Series Saga Collection Multipack features a six-piece lineup. You will find Queen Amidala, Anakin Skywalker, a Galactic Marine, Luke Skywalker in his X-wing pilot gear, IG-88, and Tessek. The most distinctive feature is the packaging, with each figure coming inside a VHS-inspired sleeve to mimic owning physical tapes.

The set is priced at $199.99 and is available for preorder now ahead of a scheduled spring 2027 release. May 2027 will mark 50 years since the original movie premiered in theaters.

Which of these six figures is your favorite? 📼✨

#StarWars #TheBlackSeries #HasbroCollector
original_title: Star Wars Is Revisiting Its Golden Era With An Exciting New 2027 Release
